command: pwd && ls -la /work && if [ -d /work/crate ]; then ls -la /work/crate; fi && /work/clock
cd /work/crate && rg --files -g '!target' -g '!Cargo.lock' && cat Cargo.toml && find src -type f -maxdepth 3 -exec sh -c 'echo "$1"; cat "$1"' sh {} \;
cd /work/crate && find . -maxdepth 4 -type f && cat Cargo.toml && find src -maxdepth 3 -type f -exec sh -c 'echo "$1"; cat "$1"' sh {} \; && rustup show active-toolchain

cd /work/crate && cat src/lib.rs && cat tests/parse.rs && cat Cargo.toml && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo clippy --offline --all-targets -- -D warnings && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo fmt -- --check && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --offline --no-deps && /work/clock
